allPairs(uint256).notice: Ordered list of every pair ever deployed

createPair(address,address).notice: Deploy a new AMM pair for tokenA / tokenB.         Reverts if either address is zero, they are identical, or the pair already exists.

feeTo().notice: Address that receives the protocol fee (if enabled)

feeToSetter().notice: Address allowed to change the feeTo address

getPair(address,address).notice: tokenA → tokenB → pair address (always stored with token0 < token1)

setFeeToSetter(address).notice: Transfer the admin role for feeTo changes

userdoc.notice: Deploys and tracks all DEXPair contracts. Based on Uniswap V2 factory pattern.
